label: Staffbase
description: Tenant users, groups, news and draft pages

operations.name: create_user
operations.description: Uses InviteUser v2. Creation and invitation effects follow Staffbase; this is not a silent-user guarantee.

operations.name: delete_user
operations.description: Permanent user deletion cannot be restored. Native code refuses users whose role is not reader.

operations.name: create_group
operations.description: No membership or administrator IDs are supplied; vendor defaults and visibility still apply.

operations.name: delete_group
operations.description: Deletion may affect access through this group; no quiet or reversible deletion guarantee.

operations.name: create_draft_post
operations.description: Does not supply publish dates or notification channels. No blanket silence guarantee.

operations.name: update_draft_post
operations.description: Requires explicit null planned/published dates; text-only localized content. Scheduled or unknown states are refused.

operations.name: delete_draft_post
operations.description: Staffbase may move a post to trash. Exact absence is checked; restoration and hard deletion are not promised.

operations.name: create_draft_page
operations.description: Sends published=false and an explicit existing space. Vendor access defaults still apply.

operations.name: update_draft_page
operations.description: Requires current membership in this space's DRAFT-filtered list; preserves other text locales.
